newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metrobank to float $100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Metrobank to float $100 mln FRCD.

text.p: Metrobank Trust and Company (Metrobank) said it will issue a $100 million, five-year floating rate certificate of deposit (FRCD) in the euromarket.

The issue, Metrobank's second in just over a year, was originally planned for $50 million but strong interest induced the bank to double the amount, Metrobank said in a statement released in Manila at the weekend.
The statement said the FRCD was the first straight five-year maturity from any domestic bank.
"At an 'all-in' yield to investors of 0.95 percent over three-month LIBOR, it carries the tightest spread for any five-year debt issue in Philippine history," the statement said.
Agreement on the issue will be signed on Monday in Hong Kong, it said, without giving details.
